subject: Kestrel Commerce - checkout 5xx + p95 spike (urgent)
messages:
From: Max Turner <max@kestrelcommerce.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kestrel Commerce Ops <ops@kestrelcommerce.com>
Date: 2026-06-24T21:05:00Z
Subject: High 5xx rate + p95 spike on checkout (starts ~20:58 UTC)

Neha,

We're seeing a sudden spike across our checkout lane starting ~20:58 UTC. Symptoms:
- 5xx rate jumped to ~18% for tokenization/callout stage
- p95 latency for inference calls ~1.8s (normally ~220ms)
- Checkout conversion dropped by ~12% in the last 8 minutes

Attached is a short CSV with request timestamps and sample trace IDs (kestrel_latency_p95.csv). Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood/kestrel/d/checkout-metrics

No config changes on our side. Can you confirm whether anything changed in peering/firewall/proxy behavior or if there are ongoing route events?

This is impacting live checkout. We need an ETA and an interim mitigation if possible.

Thanks,
Max Turner
Sr. SRE, Kestrel Commerce
Attachment: kestrel_latency_p95.csv (text/csv)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-24T21:12:00Z
Subject: Re: High 5xx rate + p95 spike on checkout (starts ~20:58 UTC)

Max — thanks for the quick heads-up and for the CSV. We see the same spikes on our side. I'm escalating immediately to network + infra. Initial ask: can you forward one full trace for a failed request (trace-id from the CSV) and confirm the client IP/subnet for those requests?

Immediate steps we're taking:
1) Opening a high-priority Jira: NET-4682 (link below).
2) Rishi and Marissa are being looped in to triage proxy/peering and firewall rules.
3) We'll prepare a short exec brief for your team and ours for any SLA/credit discussion.

Temporary mitigation options to attempt while we triage: failover to the alternate ingress region (we can route your calls to us-east-2) or enable a short proxy bypass if you can accept a quick DNS target change. Which would be preferable for you in the next 30–45 minutes?

I'll update you within 20 minutes with initial findings.

Neha Kapoor
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-24T21:26:00Z
Subject: Re: High 5xx rate + p95 spike on checkout (starts ~20:58 UTC)

Quick triage notes (initial):
- Observed symptoms line up with transient DNS resolution delays from our edge -> peering partner. Several edge nodes saw 300–600ms DNS lookup times starting 20:56 UTC which cascaded into proxy queueing.
- Peering telemetry shows asymmetric path for the Kestrel prefix: three AS-level path changes around 20:55–20:58 UTC, likely due to a flapping upstream intermediate.
- Proxy pool for the Kestrel route exceeded connection backlog in two POPs, which manifested as 502/504 and long tail latencies.

Relevant log excerpt (sanitized):
"[2026-06-24T20:57:12Z] dns_resolve(kestrel.checkout.prod) -> 412ms; upstream AS: 64512 -> 3356 -> 7018 (changed)"
"[2026-06-24T20:58:03Z] proxy-conn-queue len=72 drop=3 -> 502"

Immediate mitigations I propose (order of preference):
A) Short-term: add an emergency bypass route for Kestrel to route to us-east-2 OR directly add an A-record in our internal DNS mapping for kestrel.checkout.prod to the alternate egress IPs (requires coordination with Kestrel).
B) Disable proxy chaining for the affected POPs for 30 minutes to allow direct egress to peering.
C) Request peering partner to re-home the prefix (operational) — longer path.

I'm attaching a quick peering trace dump (peering-trace.txt). I'm going to start pushing a failover plan to infra now; need Neha's sign-off to proceed with DNS A-record override or region failover.

Rishi
Principal Network SRE, Redwood Inference
Attachment: peering-trace.txt (text)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-24T21:34:00Z
Subject: Re: High 5xx rate + p95 spike on checkout (starts ~20:58 UTC)

Thanks Rishi — that matches what I'm seeing in the Kestrel traces. Max, quick question: Do you have any constraint that prevents a DNS A-record override for kestrel.checkout.prod (we can short-circuit to our us-east-2 egress) or would you prefer we change the target region on our side? A-record override is fastest but requires you to accept a short TTL bump.

Vivek — I'm escalating to you for an executive summary and approval for the proposed failover and any short-term SLA handling (credits/notice). This is customer-impacting checkout failures for a live account. Proposed action: enable A-record override + disable proxy chaining for the 3 affected POPs for 30m; monitor p95 and 5xx targets. If approved, infra will apply and we'll coordinate a DNS TTL change with Kestrel.

I will patch updates to the Jira every 10 minutes.

Neha
Attachment: —

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-25T02:18:00Z
Subject: Exec update: Kestrel checkout outage response + recommended actions

Team — quick exec note for transparency and approval. Timeline & ask: 
- 20:56 UTC: Kestrel reported spike in 5xx/p95 (Max).
- 20:57–21:05 UTC: Edge DNS latencies observed; proxy queueing and connection backlog produced 502/504.
- 21:12 UTC: Customer notified and failover options discussed.
- 21:26 UTC: Rishi identified asymmetric peering + DNS delay root cause and recommended A-record override + proxy-chain disable.

Ask: approve emergency A-record override and proxy chaining disable for up to 45 minutes. Risk: short-lived deviation from default routing, possible minor cache churn, operational risk to session affinity for long-lived connections. Benefit: immediate reduction in p95 and 5xx for Kestrel live checkout.

If approved I authorize infra to execute mitigation now. Post-mortem will include: detailed peering telemetry, action timeline, and customer incident report (short and full). We should prepare standard SLA remediation language for Kestrel (credits if revenue impact confirmed) and update Account + Legal.

I've drafted a one-page exec brief (exec-brief-kestrel.pdf) for sales/leadership review. Please ACK or suggest changes within 15 minutes so we can execute.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
Attachment: exec-brief-kestrel.pdf (application/pdf)
